title.narrative: Emergency Relief and Early Recovery Response Programme - Bangladesh June 2012

description.narrative:
Heavy incessant rain from 21 to 28 June 2012 caused landslide and flash floods in five districts; Chittagong, Bandarban, Cox’s Bazar, Sylhet and Sunamganj. Loca schools and buildings are used as shelters and rescue operations is led by the army since 26 June. As of 4 July, a total of 122 people died (Chittagong 35, Bandarban 37, Cox’s Bazar 47 and Sylhet 3) due to landslides, broken of walls and drowning.
Caritas was part of the UN OCHA led assessment. Following needs assessment, at the request of the affected community and local government, Caritas has planned to undertake Emergency Relief and Early Recovery response for the affected families in three districts. Caritas Bangladesh made an emegency appeal (EA 25/2012) through CI on 9/7/12. The total budget proposed is Euro 1,151,974.The program includes direct food and cash distribution for 9,536 families, cash for works for 8,744 families and house repair for 2,331 families in Bandarban, Cox’s Bazar and Sylhet districts. This programme will be implemented from 5 July to 31 October 2012.
CAFOD is contributing £50,000 from the General Emergency Budget towards this appeal, earmarking cash and cash for work.
